 LaMelo Ball fills stat sheet in Saturday's loss to Bulls 
 by Chris Schommer | Timberwolves Correspondent | Sun, Nov 15th 2026, 8:38am EST 
 LaMelo Ball filled the stat sheet for the Timberwolves Saturday night, dishing out six assists, recording four steals, grabbing eight rebounds, and scoring 19 points (7-25 FG, 4-19 3PT, 1-2 FT) in a 117-106 loss to the Bulls. 
 Fantasy Impact: 
 Ball continues a dynamic stretch on both ends of the floor, grabbing two or more rebounds, dishing out five or more assists, and scoring 19 or more points in each of his last five contests. The guard remains one of the more impactful options as part of a versatile Minnesota starting five missing guard Anthony Edwards, averaging 18.6 points, 1.9 steals, 3.6 rebounds, and 6.2 assists per game while posting a usage rate of 28.4% so far this season.
